files.pets/cats.md:
# Cats

Miso and Tofu are our two cats.

## Sleep

They sleep up to sixteen hours a day, mostly on the sofa in the afternoon.

## Vet

Annual check-up is in March; vaccinations every three years.

## Food

Tofu is allergic to chicken, so only fish-based food.
files.pets/dog-training.md:
# Dog training

The puppy pulls on the leash. Practice loose-leash walking for ten minutes before breakfast and reward with small treats.

## Recall

Use a long line in the park and call her name once.
files.kitchen/sourdough.md:
# Sourdough

## Starter

Feed the starter with equal weights of flour and water the night before.

## Proofing

Shape the loaf, then let it proof for 12 hours in the fridge before baking at 250 °C.
files.kitchen/curry.md:
# Weeknight curry

Fry onion, garlic and ginger, add the spice paste, then coconut milk and chickpeas. Simmer 20 minutes and finish with lime and coriander.
files.work/launch.md:
# Product launch

The public release is scheduled for 14 November. Marketing needs final screenshots by 7 November.

## Risks

The payment provider migration may slip by a week.
files.work/standup.md:
# Team standup notes

Anna is blocked on the database migration. Ben finished the login page redesign. Next sprint planning is on Thursday.
files.work/hiring.md:
# Hiring

We are interviewing two backend engineers. The take-home exercise is a small REST API; review it with the rubric in the shared drive.
files.budget/2026.md:
# Household budget

| item | cost |
|---|---|
| rent | 1200 |
| groceries | 400 |

The vet expense is the hardest to predict.
files.finance/taxes.md:
# Tax return

Collect the payslips, the bank interest statement and the receipts for charitable donations. The filing deadline is 31 July.
files.health/running.md:
# Running plan

Three easy runs a week, one long run on Sunday. Increase the distance by at most ten percent per week to avoid shin splints.
files.health/sleep.md:
# Sleep hygiene

No screens after 22:30, keep the bedroom cool, and get up at the same time every day, even on weekends.
files.travel/japan.md:
# Japan trip

Fly into Osaka, three nights in Kyoto, then the shinkansen to Tokyo. Buy a Suica card at the airport.
files.travel/packing.md:
# Packing list

Passport, charger, adapter plug, rain jacket, walking shoes, medication.
files.garden/tomatoes.md:
# Tomatoes

Sow indoors in March, plant out after the last frost, pinch out side shoots and water at the base every morning.
files.home/boiler.md:
# Boiler

If the pressure drops below 1 bar, open the filling loop until the gauge reads 1.5 bar. Annual service is due in October.
files.tech/backup.md:
# Backups

The laptop backs up nightly to the NAS with restic; a monthly copy goes to an external drive kept at the office.
files.tech/rust-notes.md:
# Rust notes

Borrowing rules: one mutable reference or any number of shared references. Use Arc<Mutex<T>> to share state across threads.
files.books/reading.md:
# Reading list

Currently reading a history of the Roman empire. Next: a novel about a lighthouse keeper.
files.notes/学习.md:
# 学习计划

每天练习三十分钟日语听力，周末复习单词。
files.music/guitar.md:
# Guitar practice

Warm up with chromatic scales, then practise the F barre chord change for five minutes a day.
